kind: Illustrative capacity budget; not a measured Linux deployment or 2-GiB-capped simulation
assumptions: Small PHP web worker pool; one PDF conversion pipeline at a time
Production deployment with prebuilt frontend assets and no development servers
Seven official document templates were converted; large filled or image-heavy submissions were not tested
limitations: Windows memory measurements do not predict Linux RSS exactly
MySQL, normal authenticated web requests and Reverb were not load-tested
Docker was unavailable, so no actual 2-GiB Linux memory cap was enforced
Default MySQL or web-worker settings can exceed this illustrative allowance
